descartes-remote-debug.comment: Combined remote debug proxy + adapter for debugging remote/local JVMs via JDWP

_readme.description: Example configuration for Claude Code using McpProxyAdapter for remote debugging
_readme.what_is_it: McpProxyAdapter combines MCPRemoteDebugProxy + McpTcpAdapter in a single process. It connects to a remote JVM via JDWP and exposes debugging tools through the MCP protocol.
requirements: Target JVM running with JDWP enabled: -agentlib:jdwp=transport=dt_socket,server=y,suspend=n,address=*:5005
Update 'command' path to absolute path to run-proxy-adapter.sh
when_to_use: Debugging local apps via JDWP (alternative to embedded mode)

vs_embedded_mode.embedded_mode: Descartes JAR embedded in target app, full toolset (20+ tools)
vs_embedded_mode.proxy_adapter_mode: Separate process connecting via JDWP, debugger-only tools (11 tools)

basic_remote.description: Connect to specific remote host and JDWP port

auto_discover_local.description: Automatically discover and connect to local JDWP process
auto_discover_local.note: Useful when target app name is known but JDWP port may vary

all_cli_args.--auto-discover: Auto-discover local JDWP processes (no value needed)
all_cli_args.--process-pattern: Pattern to match process name for auto-discovery

environment_variables.note: CLI arguments take precedence over environment variables

example_1_local_debugging.scenario: Debug local application with JDWP enabled

example_4_auto_discover.scenario: Auto-discover local JDWP process by name
example_4_auto_discover.note: Useful when JDWP port is dynamic or unknown

components: MCPRemoteDebugProxy: Connects to target JVM via JDWP, exposes MCP tools
McpTcpAdapter: Bridges stdin/stdout JSON-RPC to TCP socket
Single process: Both run together, proxy on background thread
architecture.data_flow: Claude Code ↔ stdin/stdout ↔ McpTcpAdapter ↔ TCP ↔ RemoteDebugProxy ↔ JDWP ↔ Target JVM

comparison.mcpservers.json: Node.js adapter for embedded mode (full toolset)
comparison.mcpservers-java-adapter.json: Java adapter for embedded mode (full toolset)
comparison.mcpservers-proxy-adapter.json: Combined proxy+adapter for remote debugging (debugger-only tools)

troubleshooting.connection_refused: Ensure target JVM has JDWP enabled and port is accessible
troubleshooting.auto_discover_fails: Check process pattern matches target JVM name, ensure jps command works
troubleshooting.tools_missing: Proxy mode only exposes debugger tools, use embedded mode for full toolset
troubleshooting.high_memory: Proxy+adapter uses ~100-150MB, this is normal for JVM processes
